messages:
Rae (PM): Design sync: final pass on the trace panel before we cut the alpha. Main ask: how do we make stack traces + request drilldown feel fast for support?
Lina (Design): Sketch uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/trace-panel-v4. Two variants: overlay flyout vs split pane. Overlay is compact, split pane keeps context. Thoughts?
Jon (Frontend): split pane wins for multi-tasking. overlay hides other info and forces extra clicks. But split pane needs responsive rules for small screens.
Priya (Backend): FYI large traces (10k spans) blow up response size if we fetch full payload. We should paginate spans and lazily fetch source payload when user expands a frame.
Marta (A11y): accessibility concerns: stack frame chevrons need visible focus, correlation ID pill should be keyboard-copyable, and the timeline scrubber must have aria-valuenow + live region updates.
Lina (Design): OK will add focus ring and make the pill a button with aria-label. For timeline we'll include live region text like "At 1.2s". Copy microcopy ideas?
Rae (PM): Copy for pill tooltip: "Copy correlation ID to clipboard". For export modal we'll use: "Export trace (JSON / HAR). Exports may include sensitive payloads."
Jon (Frontend): implementation note: copy action should show an accessible toast with role=status and dismiss on Esc. Also emit analytics event `trace.copy_correlation_id`.
Priya (Backend): export flow: return 202 + export_id, background job streams to S3 and we return signed URL when ready. Endpoint example:
```
POST /api/v1/traces/{id}/export
body: { "format": "json", "include_payloads": true }
resp: 202 { "export_id": "ex_789" }
GET /api/v1/exports/ex_789 -> 200 { "url": "https://s3..." }
```
Lina (Design): UX question: if include_payloads=true we should surface a PII warning checkbox and make include opt-in. Priya ok?
Priya (Backend): yes, force explicit opt-in. Also rate-limit exports per org and debounce the export button client-side to prevent duplicate jobs.
Marta (A11y): modal must trap focus, announce with aria-modal and aria-labelledby, and the PII checkbox should have aria-describedby linking to a short explainer. Provide keyboard-only flows for export.
Rae (PM): Analytics: track export_initiated, export_included_payloads=true/false, export_completed, and export_failed. Also track copy_correlation_id. We want to know how often support exports full payloads.
Lina (Design): layout decision: split pane on desktop, overlay on mobile. Will add a collapsed stack list on the left and the timeline on the right; expanding a stack frame fetches source and shows expanded code with line highlight.
Jon (Frontend): client should request /traces/{id}?frames=summary then on expand /traces/{id}/frames/{frame_id}?full=true. This avoids huge initial payloads. We'll add a small loading skeleton for expanded frames.
Marta (A11y): tooltips with file+line should also be accessible via a keyboard "i" info button and not only on hover. Screen reader should read "File: main.py, line 42".
Rae (PM): decision recap: split pane desktop, overlay mobile; correlation ID pill prominent with copy + history; export requires opt-in for payloads + PII modal + rate-limits; accessibility gating for focus, live regions, and keyboard flows. Owners: Lina (design), Jon (frontend), Priya (backend), Marta (a11y).
ci-bot: CI: design/trace-panel-v4 -> staging deploy queued for 2026-04-02T09:00Z
Lina (Design): I'll post updated frames and microcopy inline in Figma. Please leave comments by EOD.
Jon (Frontend): will prototype keyboard copy & accessible toast, and push API contract to the spec repo.
Priya (Backend): will add export job queue + signed url path. Also adding guard: if include_payloads && user not allowed -> 403.
Marta (A11y): I'll run a quick keyboard walkthrough once Lina updates. Small follow-up: ensure color of file badges meets 4.5:1 contrast at small text sizes.
Rae (PM): thanks all. if no objections i'll merge layout decision into the alpha branch tomorrow.
